// Replays Grafana Tempo's public vocabulary helper; no Pulse code participates.
// Run from the verified Tempo checkout documented in README.md.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"

	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/search"
)

func main() {
	names := search.GetVirtualIntrinsicValues()
	sort.Strings(names)
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(names); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
